reforms.description: The Administration requested $100 million in support for charter schools in the FY 1998 budget, aiming to establish another 3,000 charter schools by the end of the decade.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Investing in charter schools enhances educational opportunities, which can lead to a more skilled workforce.
reforms.status_evidence: The funding request was made in the FY 1998 budget.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the funding request is not a structural overhaul but an extension of existing support.
reforms.source_quote: The Administration, despite teachers’ union opposition, requested $100 million in support in the FY 1998 budget (double this year’s expenditure and up from $5 million in FY 1995), targeting the establishment of another 3 000 charter schools by the end of the decade.

reforms.description: The Advanced Technology Program (ATP) provides funding to assist US businesses in applying or commercializing new scientific discoveries, aiming to strengthen links between the research community and enterprises.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By funding the commercialization of scientific discoveries, ATP enhances innovation and competitiveness in the private sector.
reforms.status_evidence: The ATP is currently operational and providing funding.
reforms.importance_rationale: The ATP is a significant program but does not represent a complete overhaul of the innovation funding landscape.
reforms.source_quote: ATP provides funding to assist US businesses to apply or commercialise new scientific discoveries.

reforms.description: The Manufacturing Extension Partnership (MEP) is a nationwide network of locally managed manufacturing extension centers that help smaller manufacturers improve their competitiveness by adopting modern technologies.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The MEP enhances the competitiveness of smaller manufacturers, facilitating technology adoption and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The MEP is currently operational and assisting manufacturers.
reforms.importance_rationale: The MEP is a significant initiative but does not represent a fundamental change in the manufacturing sector.
reforms.source_quote: MEP is a nation-wide network of locally managed manufacturing extension centres dedicated to helping smaller manufacturers improve their competitiveness by adopting modern technologies.
